name: settings-refused-project-file
description: The page applies the start document of a project, reads the same settings from the host, and when the host notifies a change whose snapshot reports that it refuses the settings file of the shown project, the page sends no further call and keeps the applied settings.
reason: The case delivers the workspace-changed notice of the host, and the Go producer runs no window and refuses a notice (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
